name: SDAIA Hexagon / Salboukh Digital Data Center
developer: Saudi Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority (SDAIA)
notes: SPA announced foundation stone for the Riyadh Hexagon government data center with 480 MW total capacity; AJi identifies the Salboukh Digital Data Center for SDAIA on a 2,800,000 sqm site with 30 MW initial IT capacity. Division assignment is based on Salbukh/Salboukh being mapped in the Huraymila area; public sources describe the facility generally as Riyadh/Salbukh.

name: DataVolt NEOM Oxagon net-zero AI factory campus
notes: NEOM announced a DataVolt agreement for a phased Oxagon AI/data-center campus; phase one is funded by an initial USD 5 billion investment and expected operational by 2028. Oxagon is on the Red Sea coast in NEOM; assigned to Duba because Oxagon/Port of NEOM is generally associated with the Duba coastal area.

name: center3 Duba Cable Landing Station data-center facility
notes: center3 describes the Duba Cable Landing Station as a state-of-the-art facility hosting the Saudi Vision cable system with Tier-III certification; treated as a data-center/CLS facility with no public MW capacity.

name: center3 Haql Cable Landing Station data-center facility
notes: center3 describes the Haql Cable Landing Station as a modern Red Sea facility hosting the Saudi Vision cable system and carrying Tier-III Data Center certification; Baxtel lists Center3 Haql CLS as a Tabuk data center. No public MW capacity found.

name: NEOM Tech & Digital / EzdiTek hyperscale data center
developer: NEOM Tech & Digital Holding Company / EzdiTek / TONOMUS
notes: NEOM announced Oracle as first tenant of a hyperscale data center at NEOM and a USD 0.5bn JV with EzdiTek; Horizons later lists a NEOM data center at 12 MW, 85% complete, part of a larger 3x12 MW hyperscale project. Assigned to Tabuk where sources only identify NEOM/Tabuk rather than a more specific governorate.
